user.title: Tarot API
user.description: Choose a data source. For krates98/tarotcardapi, run the Node app (e.g. in a VM or container) and set the base URL to that server (port is usually 3000). Images are served at /tarotdeck/ on the same host.

error.invalid_url: URL must start with http:// or https://
error.krates_need_own_url: Enter the URL of your Tarot Card API server (not tarotapi.dev). Example: http://192.168.1.50:3000
